independent_oracle.force: CCSD(T)-corrected Lambda supplied to analytic gradient.

limitations: Separate allocations on shared nodes; one cold/changed sample and two warm samples per variant, without interleaved confidence intervals.
Memcheck timing is retained but excluded from speed comparisons.
The logical n^4 iteration space, bounded grid and dense bytes remain; scatter stores include same-thread duplicates for repeated indices.
The reference cache ends after each standalone RHF call; the MO provider builds its own source.
Public CCSD(T) forces remain limited to 28 AOs. No 56-AO degenerate response extension is qualified.

measured_source.explanation: The frozen tree contains the final scientific code, native tests and initial decision note. The later evidence commit only adds measurements and rationale.

qualification.native_eri_tiles: CUDA s/p/d/f full and rectangular ERI tiles, both batch items PASS
qualification.native_eri_tiles_scope: Independent CPU integrals for complete and asymmetric rectangular tensors, s/p/d/f in Cartesian and real spherical order, two distinct batch items. The probe is built locally with ccache against the final library.

timing_boundary: Complete prepared energy or energy+forces endpoint, cold/twice-warm/changed atom 1 z by +0.01 Bohr. Preparation is separate.
work_interpretation: Each list follows cold/warm/warm-repeat/changed. The RHF reference orbit census is unchanged from the parent. The energy-side MO source completes one full-basis read per call; contraction counts are derived from that observed full tile and the independently tested producer schedule, not GPU atomic instrumentation. The baseline MO producer contracted every dense slot. Dense source values/bytes, bounded-grid launched threads and public CC work counters are unchanged. Force-only raw-provider work is not separately counted by the public energy diagnostics.
